requirements.title: Executing a top-level WHERE statement or construct establishes control and pending masks
requirements.definition: Executing a WHERE statement or where-construct-stmt establishes a control mask. Executing a WHERE construct statement also establishes a pending control mask. For a statement that is not part of a where-body-construct, the mask-expr is evaluated, the control mask becomes that value, and a top-level WHERE construct establishes the pending control mask as the logical negation of that mask value.
requirements.oracle:
Use side-effect-free masks with preloaded sentinel values. This rule establishes top-level control masks; nested conjunction is p7/p8 and per-element assignment effects remain 10.2.1.3 dependencies.

S10.2.3.2-001 WHERE masking runtime fixtures: three complete run/effect/f2023 programs execute a top-level WHERE statement and two top-level WHERE constructs with side-effect-free logical array masks. The statement case declares INTEGER actual(-2:3), preloads every element with a distinct negative sentinel, assigns coordinate-specific RHS values under the mask [.TRUE.,.FALSE.,.TRUE.,.FALSE.,.TRUE.,.FALSE.], and checks selected and unselected elements directly. The construct-then case uses a construct without ELSEWHERE to show that its initial control mask selects only true-mask elements. The ELSEWHERE case uses initial mask [T,F,F,T,F,T] and a masked-ELSEWHERE mask [T,T,F,T,F,F]; direct final values 101,202,303,104,305,106 show that the construct pending mask is the complement of the initial mask and feeds later ELSEWHERE branches. No expected value is computed with MERGE, PACK, COUNT, UNPACK or an equivalent selection intrinsic.

review_rationale: batch109: independent fresh-context source review against pinned J3/24-007 (sha256 7371e889...). Reviewer read all 30 base units of 10.2.3.1 and 10.2.3.2 in the original PDF, verified 30 base / 57 fine units, 28 requirements and 75 facets (all pending), and confirmed every unit is accounted exactly once. The accounting claim was verified by recomputing the suite accounting algorithm against the base commit: the twelve numbered items R1042 through R1050 and C1035 through C1037 are all in 10.2.3.1 and were already accounted, 10.2.3.2 contains no numbered item, and the 18 newly accounted units are 10.2.3.1 p1, p2 and its note plus every 10.2.3.2 unit. The reviewer independently derived the control mask and pending control mask semantics from the source before comparing: a top-level WHERE establishes the control mask to the mask value and a top-level construct also establishes the pending control mask to its negation; each mask expression is evaluated at most once per execution of its statement; a masked ELSEWHERE takes the previous pending control mask mc, sets the control mask to mc, then sets pending to mc and not mask, then sets control to mc and mask; a bare ELSEWHERE takes the current pending mask and establishes no new pending mask; END WHERE restores both masks; a nested WHERE construct sets pending to mc and not inner then control to mc and inner, while a nested WHERE statement sets control to mc and inner and does not alter pending. The catalogue states these transitions directly from p1 through p8, correctly separating the p7 nested-construct pending-mask behaviour from the p8 nested-statement behaviour, and no requirement or facet relies on the informative example as authority. Exactly one permission is recorded and was adjudicated from the sentence: p13 says the execution of a function reference in the mask expression of a WHERE statement is permitted to affect entities in the assignment statement, and the wording is expressly the WHERE statement rather than a construct statement or masked ELSEWHERE. No local element-assignment-order latitude exists in 10.2.3, so leaving per-element order, snapshot and temporary issues to the registered 10.2.1.3 is correct rather than a demotion. Masking oracle discipline was checked: plans require distinguishable sentinels so unselected-element assertions cannot be vacuous, no plan computes expected masking with MERGE, PACK, COUNT or an equivalent intrinsic, the p2 at-most-once facets are source-control only with no call-count oracle, and the unobservability limits are scoped to order, call counts, side effects, temporaries, short-circuiting and storage rather than suppressing directly observable branch membership. Decision: source-eligible, no blocking findings; two non-blocking observations recorded in doc/source_audits/batch_109.json. This registers source accounting only: it is not fixture approval, it supplies no execution, and it approves no oracle.
